name: PromptZone

sources.title: PromptZone homepage - community site for AI builders: posts, prompts library, guides, resources

conditions: Posting is free but requires creating an account ('Log in' / 'Create account' in nav)
This is a community posting surface, not a product listing — visibility comes from writing a post (e.g. a tool announcement, tutorial, or tested prompt) that the community reads
requirements: Audience is AI builders, prompt engineers, and creators — content must fit that niche
PromptZone positions its prompts as 'run in a sandbox against the target model, with the output shown' — prompts shared are expected to be tested
Governed by a Code of Conduct (linked in footer)
preparation: A post worth publishing: tool launch write-up, guide, or a tested prompt with real output
Relevant tags (ai, tutorial, tools, llm, imagegeneration, etc.)
workflow: Write a post introducing the product — a tutorial or 'how we built it' angle will outperform a bare link drop
Engage with comments; posts are sorted by Relevant/Latest/Top
watchFor: Not a directory — there is no 'submit product' form; the asset is a community post that links out
Pure self-promotion without substance will likely underperform or be moderated
An 'Advertise' link in the footer offers a paid route if organic posting is not enough
Many top posts are prompt/tutorial content — product launches compete with educational posts
countsAsLive: The post is publicly visible on promptzone.com in the Latest feed and under its tags
unknowns: Whether profile/post links are dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
